subjects.note: Route/arrows 4/4; normals and hit-point markings 3/4; reflection geometry 2/4; turning-mirror explanation 3/4; exit explanations 4/4. Two turns and useful dashed normals are a clear improvement. S1 lacks an explicit mirror/hit-point label and right-angle square. In S2 both mirrors tilt up-right (/), but the second ray travels left: that mirror should send the upward ray right. To send it left, tilt Mirror 2 down-right (\) and turn its normal too. Equal-angle marks are missing. S3 needs to say the normal turns with the mirror. Do not judge precise angles from a photographed freehand sketch; check the actual direction at Mirror 2. Both exit responses express the intended rule, but do not cure the drawing mismatch.
